raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: fpsample
  version: "1.0.2"

package:
  name: ${{ name|lower }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/leonardodalinky/fpsample/archive/v${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: d734aac0873907f8d58aa07ae7336f0aecefb1338bdfd262831c80aeded75201

build:
  number: 2
  script:
    - if: win
      then: call "%RECIPE_DIR%\\build.bat"
    - if: unix
      then: bash "${RECIPE_DIR}/build.sh"

requirements:
  build:
    - ${{ compiler("cxx") }}
    - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
    - cmake
    - ninja
    - if: unix
      then: make
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then:
        - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
        - pip
        - python
        - scikit-build-core >=0.11
  host:
    - pip
    - python
    - scikit-build-core >=0.11
    - pybind11 >=2.10
    - numpy
    - if: win
      then: cmake
  run:
    - numpy >=1.16.0
    - python

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - fpsample
  - script:
      - pip check
      - python run_test.py
    files:
      recipe:
        - run_test.py
    requirements:
      run:
        - pip
        - python

about:
  homepage: https://github.com/leonardodalinky/fpsample
  repository: https://github.com/leonardodalinky/fpsample
  summary: Python efficient farthest point sampling (FPS) library
  license: MIT
  license_file:
    - LICENSE

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - jeongseok-meta
